findings: DEX Screener exact-pair lookup was consistently reachable throughout the bounded test.
No migrated pair was available immediately; most first appeared around the provider's 30-second cache boundaries by the 60-second probe.
One of ten required the 120-second probe, so the earlier three-token result of universal visibility by 60 seconds did not generalize.
This verifies useful delayed enrichment, not a maximum indexing bound, completeness promise, or migration authority.
